headline: Keith Tyser surges into ARC-3 gold places

sections.text: Keith Tyser climbed from 66th to 13th, gaining 4.48 points to reach 37.22 and enter the 18 gold places.
The gold cutoff rose to 36.14, leaving keithtyser 0.35 above the first team outside the medal places.
